name: crema-shell
description: Capacitor shell for Crema. The web app is the repo root and stays buildless; this directory only wraps it.

scripts.sync: node sync.mjs && cap sync && node configure-native.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
